department: Delhi Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (DBOCWWB)

eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Registered with DBOCWWB in Delhi (NCT); Haryana (HBOCWWB) / UP (UPBOCWWB) excluded.
eligibility_criteria.category_rules: Registered female worker or spouse of registered male worker.
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Lapsed memberships or beyond 2 live deliveries.
